verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a 'Search UI Components' section in the official install docs (typesense-docs-31), which suggests first-party UI components exist but gives no detail on what they cover. Live demo sites (typesense-docs-62) show complete search interfaces but do not show they were built from reusable component libraries. A 2020 HN request for InstantSearch-level UI libraries reflects an early gap, not a concrete contradiction of current docs. Missing for 10: documentation of specific components (search box, results, facets, pagination), framework coverage (JS/React/Vue/mobile), setup or usage guides, and hands-on corroboration.
